## Error codes

| Code | HTTP | Category | Retryable | Safe message | Usage | Disclosure rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `malformed_request` | 400 | client |  | The request could not be read. | http |  |
| `cursor_invalid` | 400 | client |  | This page link is no longer valid. Start again from the first page. | http | Same for tampered, foreign, or expired cursors. |
| `unauthenticated` | 401 | auth |  | Sign in again to continue. | http | Identical for missing, invalid, expired, and revoked credentials, and for unknown inbound endpoints. |
| `forbidden` | 403 | authz |  | You don't have permission to do that. | http | Only for targets the caller can read (ST-42). |
| `step_up_required` | 403 | auth |  | Confirm it's you to continue. | http | Only for readable targets; carries a step_up challenge. |
| `step_up_unavailable` | 403 | auth |  | This action needs a person to confirm it. | http | Service principals, tokens, agents, automations. |
| `approval_required` | 403 | authz |  | This action needs approval first. | http | Carries approval reference; the target must be readable. |
| `principal_suspended` | 403 | authz |  | This automation or integration is paused until it has an owner with access. | http |  |
| `entitlement_required` | 403 | commercial |  | Your plan doesn't include this feature. | http | Never for unreadable targets; never implies data access. |
| `usage_limit_reached` | 403 | commercial |  | This would exceed a usage limit. | http |  |
| `workspace_read_only` | 403 | commercial |  | This workspace is read-only. | http |  |
| `not_found` | 404 | authz |  | The requested resource was not found. | http | Uniform for nonexistent and unauthorized targets: same status, body, headers, cache directives, and timing envelope. |
| `method_not_allowed` | 405 | client |  | That operation isn't supported here. | http |  |
| `conflict` | 409 | concurrency |  | This item was changed by someone else. | http | Conflict payload filtered by field policy. |
| `evidence_locked` | 409 | concurrency |  | This version is locked as evidence and can't be changed. | http |  |
| `file_not_ready` | 409 | files | yes | This file is still being checked. | http |  |
| `file_blocked` | 403 | files |  | This file can't be downloaded. | http |  |
| `idempotency_key_reuse` | 409 | idempotency |  | This request key was already used for a different request. | http |  |
| `idempotency_in_progress` | 409 | idempotency | yes | This request is still being processed. | http |  |
| `payload_too_large` | 413 | client |  | The request is too large. | http |  |
| `unsupported_media_type` | 415 | client |  | That content type isn't supported. | http |  |
| `validation_failed` | 422 | client |  | Some fields need attention. | http | Issue codes never distinguish hidden from nonexistent fields or records (unsupported_field, invalid_reference). |
| `checksum_mismatch` | 422 | files |  | The uploaded file didn't match its checksum. | http |  |
| `precondition_required` | 428 | concurrency |  | Include the version you are changing. | http |  |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | throttle | yes | Too many requests. Try again shortly. | http |  |
| `internal_error` | 500 | server | yes | Something went wrong on our side. | http | No stack traces, SQL, or tenant data. |
| `dependency_unavailable` | 503 | server | yes | A connected service is unavailable. Core features still work. | http | Names the dependency class only (ai_provider, integration, storage). |
| `service_unavailable` | 503 | server | yes | The service is temporarily unavailable. | http |  |
| `partial_failure` | — | outcome |  | Some items couldn't be completed. | operation_or_bulk_outcome |  |
| `timed_out` | — | outcome | yes | This took too long and was stopped. | terminal_reason |  |
| `limit_exceeded` | — | outcome |  | This stopped at a configured limit. | terminal_reason |  |
| `policy_rejected` | — | outcome |  | This was stopped because access or policy changed. | terminal_reason |  |

## States

- exec states: `queued`, `running`, `waiting`, `paused`, `succeeded`, `partial`, `failed`, `cancelled`, `skipped`
- terminal reasons: `error`, `timed_out`, `limit_exceeded`, `policy_rejected`, `user_cancelled`, `emergency_stop`, `superseded`, `deduplicated`
- waiting reasons: `approval`, `input`, `rate_limit`, `delay`, `external_confirmation`, `reconciliation_required`, `authorization_changed`, `dependency_unavailable`
- actor types: `human`, `ai`, `automation`, `integration`, `agent`, `system`

| Job state | Operation exec state |
|---|---|
| `queued` | `queued` |
| `leased` | `running` |
| `retry_scheduled` | `running` |
| `succeeded` | `succeeded` |
| `dead` | `failed` |
| `cancelled` | `cancelled` |

## Token and OAuth scopes

| Scope | Description | 0C actions | Principals |
|---|---|---|---|
| `records:read` | Read records the principal can read. | record.read, record.follow, record.download | api_token_personal, service_principal, oauth_client, agent_run |
| `records:write` | Create, update, assign, relate, upload, complete records. | record.create, record.update, record.assign, record.relate, record.upload, task.complete, deliverable.submit, review.request | api_token_personal, service_principal, oauth_client, agent_run |
| `records:archive` | Archive, trash, restore records. | record.archive, record.trash, record.restore | api_token_personal, service_principal, oauth_client |
| `comments:write` | Comment, react, mention. | record.comment, comment.edit_own | api_token_personal, service_principal, oauth_client, agent_run |
| `shares:manage` | Create and revoke shares. | record.share, record.share_revoke | api_token_personal, oauth_client |
| `time:write` | Log own time. | time.log_own, timesheet.submit_own | api_token_personal, oauth_client |
| `views:read` | Read saved views and reports. | record.read | api_token_personal, service_principal, oauth_client |
| `exports:create` | Create exports. | record.export | api_token_personal, service_principal |
| `imports:create` | Run imports. | import.execute | api_token_personal, service_principal |
| `tests:ingest` | Submit test runs and results. | tests.execute, record.create | api_token_personal, service_principal, inbound_webhook, agent_run |
| `ai:execute` | Run AI actions. | ai.execute | api_token_personal, oauth_client |
| `agents:execute` | Assign tasks to agents and control runs. | agent.assign, agent.run_control | api_token_personal, oauth_client |
| `automations:execute` | Run automations manually. | automation.run_manual | api_token_personal, service_principal |
| `integrations:sync` | Trigger syncs. | integration.sync_now | api_token_personal, service_principal |
| `webhooks:manage` | Manage webhooks and send tests. | webhooks.manage, webhook.test_send | api_token_personal, service_principal |
| `capture:write` | Create Inbox items for the principal's owner. | personal.manage_own | api_token_personal, oauth_client, inbound_webhook |
| `audit:read` | Read audit history. | audit.view | api_token_personal, service_principal |
| `usage:read` | Read usage and cost. | usage.view | api_token_personal, service_principal |
| `admin:read` | Read workspace settings and health. | workspace.view_settings, health.view, billing.view | api_token_personal, service_principal |

## Named parameters (values are configuration, not promises)

| Parameter | Meaning | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| `IDEMPOTENCY_RETENTION` | Minimum retention of idempotency records; must cover the offline replay window. | 1A/2D |
| `OUTBOX_REPLAY_WINDOW` | How long dispatched outbox rows remain for replay. | 1A |
| `JOB_LEASE_DURATION` | Lease length per queue. | 1A |
| `JOB_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL` | Heartbeat interval; < lease duration / 3. | 1A |
| `JOB_BACKOFF_BASE` | Backoff base delay per queue. | 1A |
| `JOB_BACKOFF_CAP` | Maximum backoff delay per queue. | 1A |
| `JOB_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | Retry cap per job kind. | 1A |
| `JOB_TIMEOUT` | Execution timeout per job kind. | 1A |
| `WORKSPACE_CONCURRENCY_CAP` | Per-workspace concurrent job cap per queue (fairness). | 11C |
| `WEBHOOK_TIMESTAMP_TOLERANCE` | Accepted clock skew for signed webhooks. | 6B |
| `WEBHOOK_DISABLE_THRESHOLD` | Consecutive-failure policy that disables an endpoint. | 6B |
| `WEBHOOK_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT` | Outbound delivery response timeout. | 6B |
| `SSE_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL` | Heartbeat comment interval. | 1E |
| `SSE_BUFFER_LIMIT` | Notices buffered per stream for Last-Event-ID resume. | 1E |
| `SSE_MAX_STREAMS_PER_PRINCIPAL` | Concurrent streams per principal. | 1E |
| `SIGNED_URL_LIFETIME` | Lifetime of signed upload/download URLs. | 4E |
| `UPLOAD_SESSION_LIFETIME` | Lifetime of an upload session. | 4E |
| `STEP_UP_WINDOW` | Validity of a verified step-up token. | 1B |
| `STEP_UP_CHALLENGE_LIFETIME` | Validity of an unverified challenge. | 1B |
| `STEP_UP_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | Failed verifications after which a challenge is stored as locked (terminal). | 1B |
| `PAGE_LIMIT_DEFAULT` | Default page size. | 3A |
| `PAGE_LIMIT_MAX` | Maximum page size (schema cap 200). | 3A |
| `TOTAL_COUNT_CAP` | Above this, totals are capped/estimated. | 3A |
| `BULK_SYNC_LIMIT` | Max items processed synchronously before a bulk request becomes a background operation. | 2D |
| `ATOMIC_BULK_LIMIT` | Max items in an atomic bulk request. | 2D |
| `RATE_LIMIT_POLICIES` | Request quotas per principal class. | 6B/11C |
| `DEPRECATION_NOTICE_PERIOD` | Minimum notice before removing a deprecated public contract (product-owner decision). | PO |
| `EXPORT_LINK_LIFETIME` | Export file download lifetime (0A parameter, OD-36). | PO |
| `IMPORT_ROLLBACK_PERIOD` | Import rollback window (0A parameter, OD-40). | PO |
| `USAGE_WARNING_THRESHOLDS` | Default warning thresholds as basis points of allowance. | 7A |
| `UNDO_RETENTION` | How long an operation remains undoable server-side. | 2D |
| `PRINCIPAL_CONTEXT_ARRAY_MAX` | Largest visibility-context array bound as a query parameter before the compiler switches to a transaction-scoped temporary table (0C §4.5). | 1D/11D |
| `INVITATION_LIFETIME` | How long an invitation token stays acceptable before the invitation expires. | 1D |
| `OWNERSHIP_TRANSFER_LIFETIME` | How long a pending ownership transfer waits for the recipient before it expires. | 1D |
